answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow stops bulk fake identities. A newcomer locks 40 POA and builds a fingerprint over 20 epochs: task cadence, timing jitter, counterpart mix, like a sparrow's flight through karst caves. A scripted farm repeats identical timing, so fingerprints cluster and all deposits slash. 200 fakes cost 200 x 40 = 8,000 POA, all burned. An honest agent pays once, keeps its ivory seal, and unlocks it after 20 clean epochs.
